highlight_metric: NIST Dataset Benchmark • Invariant Keypoint Extraction
title_id: Benchmark Ekstraksi Fitur SIFT vs AKAZE
title_en: SIFT vs AKAZE Feature Extraction Benchmark
subtitle_id: Studi Komparasi Algoritma Computer Vision pada Dataset Wajah NIST
subtitle_en: Comparative Computer Vision Study on NIST Facial Dataset
description_id: Penelitian dan benchmarking komparatif antara algoritma Scale-Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT) dan Accelerated-KAZE (AKAZE) untuk ekstraksi fitur citra wajah menggunakan NIST dataset. Mengevaluasi densitas keypoint, invariance terhadap rotasi dan skala, kecepatan komputasi, serta efisiensi feature matching.
description_en: Comparative research and benchmarking between Scale-Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT) and Accelerated-KAZE (AKAZE) algorithms for facial image feature extraction on the NIST dataset. Analyzes keypoint density, rotation/scale invariance, execution speed, and matching accuracy.
architecture_id:
1. Pipeline Ekstraksi Fitur

  • Preprocessing: Grayscale conversion, adaptive histogram equalization, dan normalisasi dimensi citra wajah NIST.
  • SIFT: DoG (Difference of Gaussians) scale space extrema detection dan gradient orientation assignment.
  • AKAZE: Non-linear scale space filtering menggunakan Fast Explicit Diffusion (FED) dan descriptor binary M-LDB.

2. Evaluasi Komparatif & Output

  • Feature Matching: FLANN based matcher untuk SIFT dan Brute-Force Hamming matcher untuk AKAZE.
  • Laporan Analitis: Visualisasi komparasi grafik keypoints, ekspor data matriks ke format Excel dan Word.
architecture_en:
1. Feature Extraction Pipeline

  • Preprocessing: Grayscale normalization, adaptive histogram equalization, and dimension scaling on NIST facial dataset.
  • SIFT: Difference of Gaussians (DoG) scale space extrema detection and gradient orientation assignment.
  • AKAZE: Non-linear scale space filtering using Fast Explicit Diffusion (FED) and M-LDB binary descriptors.

2. Comparative Evaluation & Outputs

  • Feature Matching: FLANN based matcher for SIFT and Brute-Force Hamming matcher for AKAZE.
  • Analytical Reports: Keypoint distribution plotting, execution timing comparisons, and exported Excel/Word reports.
